information:
### Volunteers

We will require volunteers to support with running, judging and scrambling on the day. We will demonstrate the process for these duties during the new competitor tutorial, and encourage everyone to get involved. You also do not have to be a competitor to volunteer! If you are a parent, family member, or friend of a competitor, please do not hesitate to volunteer if you would like to help the competition run smoothly.
